content.text: {"title":"Ubud Eats and Surprise Beats","summary":"A slower Ubud day built around food: market-style bites, a proper long dinner, and one unexpected nightlife stop to close it out.","stops":[{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A gentle first bite in Ubud, easy on the late-starting crew and full of things to share."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A little history between meals, quick enough to keep the day lazy."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A slow green walk to stretch the legs and build an appetite, no rush at all."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The big sit-down splurge stays put, terima kasih (thank you) very much."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The surprise: after all that Ubud calm, a loud golden-hour beach club for the night owls."}]}
